newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil probes "dumping" by six countries.
newsitem.headline: Brazil probes "dumping" by six countries.

text.p: Brazil Monday started anti-dumping probes against imports of insecticides, a rubber product and glasswort from six countries, the Ministry of Industry and Commerce said.

The ministry, in a circular published in the Official Journal, said it found there was sufficient cause to suspect dumping of insecticide spray based on magnesium phosphate from Chile and butadiene-styrene rubber from the United States.
It said there was also good reason to investigate dumping of several types of glasswort -- the basic material for making glass -- from the United States, Bulgaria, Poland, Spain and Romania.
If investigators found that the imports were being sold at below cost, causing significant damage to the domestic industry, the government could set up anti-dumping measures such as punitive tariffs.
